correctness.rationale: The actual verifier reconstructs the Cianci--Ottina 16-point height-three poset, checks 48 order-complex edges and 32 triangles, verifies an explicit integral 2-chain with boundary twice the torsion cycle, an integral cocycle dual to the free generator, and a mod-2 cocycle dual to the torsion generator. Its rank checks are consistent with H_1=Z plus Z/2. Exhaustive monotone-map recursion gives exactly 7,678,760 maps and the ten stated triples, with exact multiplicities; 16 maps satisfy k=plus-or-minus-one and delta=1, and these coincide map-by-map with the 16 bijections. The opposite model has the same order-preserving self-functions after order reversal. Goncalves--Kelly Lemma 3.1 independently confirms the claimed classical parity comparison.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a sharp direct-map realization boundary on a canonical cardinality-minimal Klein-bottle model: the classical infinite free multiplier collapses to three values while preserving the torsion parity pattern. That exact truncation is a natural and reusable measure of information lost by cardinality-minimal finite models.

final_claim: For either 16-point minimal finite Klein-bottle model there are exactly 7,678,760 continuous self-maps and exactly ten induced endomorphisms of H_1 isomorphic to Z plus Z/2: t maps to delta t and x maps to kx+epsilon t with k in {-1,0,1}, epsilon in Z/2, and delta=0 when k=0; all ten occur, and the 16 H_1 isomorphisms are exactly the 16 homeomorphisms.
